TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Tindal training area
DATE 14 June 2030 · 0700 local
SIDE Royal Australian Navy
WINDOW 75 min, closes at 112
RQ-7 Shadow. Photo: U.S. Army JMRC by Sgt. Maria Tsukino · Public domain · cropped
"Readiness is critical to an effective deterrence, not only in Air Force, but across all domains."
- Air Vice-Marshal Harvey Reynolds, Deputy Chief of Air Force, RAAF

TINDAL JOINT FIRES RANGE, 2030. This is a labelled exercise branch. An allied demonstration section brings a K9 and a PzH 2000; the opposing instrumented batteries use 2S19 and 2S43 models. They can return fire. The lesson is reconnaissance, target allocation and counter-battery timing, not a free barrage.

ELLIS has MOTH 21, a small RQ-7, and a portable launcher and local recovery lane. Work an oblique track, classify both gun positions, then choose which battery to suppress first. Your guns start with weapons held. The range safety buildings are protected. A red spider has been painted under the school sign; Ellis will not say whether it is the original one.
COMMAND NET: A mission-specific tactical report follows eight minutes after the start. It is advice from the command team, not a new sensor detection.
Major Elena Ward, Joint Fires School; Sergeant Ellis, UAV section
COMMANDER'S INTENT
Use the forward UAV to classify each battery before allocating fire. Keep the K9 and PzH 2000 alive, and leave the marked safety buildings alone.
• Silence both opposing gun batteries
• Preserve both allied guns
• Harm no range-safety buildings
• Classify both gun positions
One K9, one PzH 2000, one RQ-7 airborne and two reserve UAVs. Opposing: a 2S19 and a 2S43 battery. Protected range-safety buildings.

The planned window is 75 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 37 minutes more; the operation is closed at 112 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
